cases.name: Aleah Noelle Aaron
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Aleah was a girl that loved life and always rolled by the seat of her pants. One of the things Aleah loved most was facetiming her nephew Braxton. She enjoyed being in nature, looking at astrology, loved animals and crystals. Some of her hobbies she enjoyed were journaling and painting, hula-hooping, and making jewelry. Aleah was a lover of music, enjoying the genres of bluegrass, grateful dead, and punk-folk. She will be missed by her family and friends."
cases.narrative: Investigators found her body in a shallow grave in a rural section of Josephine County near Cave Junction.
